comment: Accepted `-Tdot` (agwrite) divergences. Each entry records one (id, engine) pair that is a documented, won't-fix difference for the -Tdot track. The walker (test/corpus/dot-walk.ts) treats a listed pair as verdict 'accepted' rather than 'diverged', excluding it from the diverged bucket while still counting it separately. Entry shape: { id, engine, reason }. Seeded from the 13-id triage smoke taken when the track was built; any addition MUST be referenced in the decision journal.
